verdict.rationale: Asana's own materials describe built-in AI Teammates. These are pre-built and custom agents that work alongside the team inside real workflows, with shared memory, scoped permissions, audit trails and an agents API endpoint. Asana also advertises AI Studio and Asana Dash as an "AI Chief of Staff", which together cover delegating work to an in-product AI assistant. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the delegation mechanics (e.g., assigning a task to an AI Teammate and reviewing its output), in-depth how-to docs beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed.
